information: # Registration is now full; all new registrations will be placed on a waitlist. To find more competitions in California, [click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=California). This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) - [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another competition held in UC Berkeley! - Gift cards to SpeedCubeShop will be provided to all 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finishers in each event! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.
